history: always-repro'd across all 20 bisectable stable releases v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607 (linear sweep, no invalid probes); earliest reproduction predates the 2021-06 report by two years
summary: Crashes in clang CodeGen, not in DXIL validation despite the title. An incomplete array type initialised by array assignment (float x[] = s.arr) reaches EmitAutoVarAlloca uncompleted and trips assert(!isIncompleteType()) in isConstantSizeType; with asserts compiled out the same input null-derefs in ConvertScalarOrVector/AddMissingCastOpsInInitList, which is the reported access violation (proved by stepping past the asserts in the debug binary). Second shape: the 5-line minimal repro does not crash on release builds but silently emits an empty entry point on all 20 releases, and as a compute restatement produces undef UAV stores that DXC own validator rejects. FXC compiles the filed shader and generates correct code; Clang HLSL front end rejects it with array initializer must be an initializer list on exactly the crashing lines. Predicate is internal_failure keyed on exit status, not message: 0xE0000001 on the debug build, 0xC0000005 on releases, one of them empty-stderr, so any message-based predicate would invent a fix boundary.
title: Internal compiler error on shader validation
